formula.title: Formula Sheet: Integers and Absolute Value

accom.intro: Integers are whole numbers. They can be positive, negative or zero. Let’s learn them one small step at a time.

skills.bigIdea: Numbers get bigger as you move to the right.
skills.name: Find integers on a number line

steps.text: Find 0 in the middle of the line.
Positive numbers are on the right of 0.
Negative numbers are on the left of 0.

tryIt.hint: Start at 0. Count 4 steps to the left.
tryIt.question: Put a dot on −4.

skills.bigIdea: Opposites are the same distance from 0, on different sides.
skills.name: Opposites

steps.text: Find the number. Count its steps from 0.
Count the same steps on the other side of 0.

tryIt.hint: Same number of steps, other side of 0.
tryIt.question: What is the opposite of 6?

skills.bigIdea: Absolute value means distance from 0. Distance is never negative.
skills.name: Absolute value

skills.bigIdea: The number further left is smaller.
skills.name: Compare integers

steps.text: Put both numbers on the number line.
Look: which one is further left?

tryIt.hint: Find the one further to the left.
tryIt.question: Which is smaller: −1 or −6?

words.defAr: عدد كامل قد يكون موجبًا أو سالبًا أو صفرًا.
words.defEn: A whole number that is positive, negative or zero.

words.defAr: ليس موجبًا ولا سالبًا، وهو منتصف خط الأعداد.
words.defEn: Not positive and not negative. The middle of the number line.
The + or − in front of a number.

words.defAr: العدد الذي له البعد نفسه عن الصفر في الجهة الأخرى.
words.defEn: The same distance from 0, on the other side.
A line that shows numbers in order.

words.defAr: بُعد العدد عن الصفر، ولا تكون سالبة أبدًا.
words.defEn: The distance of a number from 0. It is never negative.
How far one point is from another.
words.example: −9 m is 9 m from sea level.

words.defAr: حجم العدد بغض النظر عن إشارته.
words.defEn: The size of a number, without its sign.

words.defAr: يحدد أي العددين أكبر أو أصغر.
words.defEn: Decide which number is greater or less.

words.defAr: يضع الأعداد من الأصغر إلى الأكبر.
words.defEn: Put numbers from least to greatest.
A number sentence that uses < or >.

words.defAr: يقع على اليمين أكثر في خط الأعداد.
words.defEn: Further to the right on the number line.

words.defAr: يقع على اليسار أكثر في خط الأعداد.
words.defEn: Further to the left on the number line.

words.defAr: الارتفاع صفر؛ ما تحته سالب وما فوقه موجب.
words.defEn: Height 0. Below it is negative, above it is positive.
words.example: A diver at −9 m is below sea level.
